about.desc: ArcBlog is a Blocklet blog: DID Wallet identity is the author credential, posts are Markdown-first, and images live in the Arc file space.
about.lifecycle-desc: Posts follow a draft → published → archived lifecycle with optimistic concurrency and a full audit trail. Soft deletes keep records recoverable.
about.title: About ArcBlog
admin.content-empty: Nothing here yet. Write your first post.
admin.gate-desc: Sign in with DID Wallet to manage drafts, published stories, archived stories, and uploaded media from one wallet-bound workspace.
admin.lifecycle-desc: Archive copies a post to the private drafts directory; Remove from public takes it off the public feed. Drafts can be published or soft-deleted from the row actions.
admin.studio-desc: Manage drafts, published stories, archived stories, and uploaded media from one wallet-bound workspace.
compose.checks-desc: Title and slug are required. Publishing is immediately public; drafts stay private until published. Saving an existing slug overwrites that record.
compose.editor-note: Compose your story in Markdown. Drafts are private in your DID user space; publishing writes validated metadata into /instance/app/arcblog/posts.
compose.gate-desc: Sign in with DID Wallet to unlock the editor. Drafts stay in the private drafts directory until published.
compose.images-desc: Drop a cover or inline image here. Media is stored in the site file space; paste the resulting URL into Markdown: ![Alt text](URL).
compose.seo-desc: Optional: set seo title/description and OG title/description/image. Defaults fall back to post title, summary, and cover image.
admin.admin-archive-msg: This writes an archived copy to private drafts. The public post stays live until you remove it from public.
admin.admin-unpublish-msg: Archive first keeps a copy in drafts. Removing from public deletes the original from public posts.
admin.admin-publish-msg: This publishes the current draft record. Deleted records can be republished.
admin.admin-delete-msg: The record stays in drafts with status deleted and can be republished later.
posts.hero-desc: Only published stories appear in the public feed. Every post remains DID-attributed and follows a draft → published → archived lifecycle.
reader.desc: This surface renders only published post records (status=published). Body remains Markdown at rest and is sanitized at render time.
reader.title: Article
settings.title: Appearance
settings.desc: Theme, tone and palette for this site. Admins set the defaults; signed-in users can personalize their own theme.
preview.title: Preview
preview.notice: Draft preview — this record is not public.
preview.published-hint: Published. The draft copy is still in studio drafts — remove it when done.
preview.preview-delete-msg: The record stays in the archive with status deleted (soft delete).
compose.slug-hint: Lowercase letters, numbers and dashes; used in the URL /posts/<slug>.
compose.cover-hint: Shown as the card cover in the story list and at the top of the article. Upload via the Images panel below, then paste the URL here.
compose.draft-saved: Draft saved — preview it from the studio.
admin.hero-admin-desc: Heroes render as the homepage carousel. Each record needs a title, an image URL, and a target link; sort orders the slides ascending.
admin.hero-id-hint: Lowercase letters, numbers and dashes; same ID overwrites.
admin.hero-delete-msg: This removes the hero record permanently.
admin.hero-dropzone-desc: Upload an image here, then paste the resulting URL into the form above.
admin.hero-quickadd-hint: Click a post row to stage it below, then confirm. Title, summary, cover and /posts/<slug> link are copied automatically.
compose-edit.title: Edit post
compose-edit.gate-desc: Sign in with DID Wallet to unlock the editor. Drafts stay in the private drafts directory until published.
compose-edit.slug-hint: Lowercase letters, numbers and dashes; used in the URL /posts/<slug>.
compose-edit.cover-hint: Shown as the card cover in the story list and at the top of the article. Upload via the Images panel below, then paste the URL here.
compose-edit.seo-desc: Optional: set seo title/description and OG title/description/image. Defaults fall back to post title, summary, and cover image.
compose-edit.images-desc: Drop a cover or inline image here. Media is stored in the site file space; paste the resulting URL into Markdown: ![Alt text](URL).
compose-edit.publish-hint: Published. The draft copy is still in studio drafts — delete it there when done.
dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.desc: Node identity, roles, taxonomy and recent activity for this ArcBlog instance.
dashboard.node-empty: No node profile yet. Run: node scripts/arcblog-node.mjs init
dashboard.categories-empty: No categories yet. Run: node scripts/arcblog-category.mjs seed
author.title: Author
author.desc: Who publishes here: this node's DID-bound author identity.
dashboard.network-desc: Role asset configuration is external (spec §9), and a role grants no capability until it is verified — studio/hub capabilities stay withheld while verification is off.
dashboard.roles-empty: No role configuration yet. Run: node scripts/arcblog-roles.mjs init
dashboard.econ-desc: Live: versioned split policy, tips, paid reading, settlement and an append-only ledger.
dashboard.agent-desc: Declared agent: arcblog-agent — read-only over published posts, taxonomy, node profile and public economy data.
dashboard.econ-empty: No settlement policy yet. Run: node scripts/arcblog-economy.mjs policy init
dashboard.agent-closed: Default-closed (spec §130): settle_payment, change_wallet, change_role never run from the agent surface.
operations.title: Operations
operations.desc: Live state of this node: health, discovery, Hubs, economy, media and agent grants.
operations.health-empty: Not published yet — run: node scripts/arcblog-network.mjs health --publish
operations.discovery-empty: Not published yet — run: node scripts/arcblog-network.mjs discovery publish
operations.hubs-empty: No Hub registered yet — run: node scripts/arcblog-network.mjs hub register --hub-did <did>
operations.policy-empty: No policy yet — run: node scripts/arcblog-economy.mjs policy init
operations.products-empty: No product yet — run: node scripts/arcblog-economy.mjs product add
operations.media-empty: No media record yet — run: node scripts/arcblog-media.mjs add
operations.agent-grants-empty: No grant — agent write tools stay refused.
operations.agent-closed: Default-closed (spec §130): settle_payment, change_wallet, change_role never run from the agent surface.
operations.mutations: This console reports state only. Value-bearing mutations (settlement, wallets, roles, payments) stay deliberate CLI actions with a DID session.
